```{r}
# load libraries
library(ggplot2)

```

```{r}
seed = 1
set.seed(1)
# Load data from southern African database

# set directory
dir = here::here()

# read in and modify data names and assign as date list for c14bazAAR
c14_za <- read_csv(paste0(dir, "/data/SARD_Mar2021_14C.csv")) |>
  rename(c14age = Date, c14std = Uncertainty,  labnr = 'Lab ID',
         lon = DecdegE, lat = DecdegS,
         material = 'Material dated', species = Species) |>
  as.c14_date_list()

```

```{r}
#filter to remove human remains as they produce errors when calibrating
za <- c14_za |>
  filter(species != "Homo sapiens" | is.na(species)) |>
  
  # filter by dates older than 200 years and less than 50 ka
  filter(c14age > 200, c14age < 50000)


# filter by terrestrial material and apply the terrestrial calibration curve
za_terr <- za |>
  filter(!material %in% c('Marine shell', 'marine shell',
                          'marine other', 'iron')) |>
  drop_na(c14age, c14std)

za_terr_cal <- rcarbon::calibrate(za_terr$c14age , za_terr$c14std,
                                      calCurves = 'shcal20',
                                      ids = za_terr$labnr)

# filter by marine material and apply marien curve and offset
za_marine <- za |>
  filter(material %in% c('Marine shell', 'marine shell',
                         'marine other')) |>
  drop_na(c14age, c14std)

za_marine_cal <- rcarbon::calibrate(za_marine$c14age, 
                                    za_marine$c14std,
                                    calCurves = rep('marine20',
                                                    length(za_marine$labnr)),
                                    resOffset = rep(187, length(za_marine$labnr)),
                                    resErrors = rep(18, length(za_marine$labnr)),
                                    ids = za_marine$labnr)

# combine data
za_cal <- rcarbon::combine(za_terr_cal, za_marine_cal)
```

```{r}
# convert dates to a tibble object and join the original table by lab ID
za_comb <- za_cal |> as_tibble() |>
  cbind(za_cal$metadata) |>
  rename(labnr = DateID) |>
  right_join(za)
```

```{r}
# filter by late pleistocene
max_age <- 10000 
min_age <- 1500
temp_res <- 500
  
za_21ka <- za_comb |>
  filter(c14age < max_age)

# generate temporal grids
time_grid <- seq(
  from = max_age,
  to = min_age,
  by = -(temp_res)
)


za_21ka$calBP <- unlist(
  
  lapply(
  
    1:length(za_21ka$grids),
  
    function(x) {
      
      val <- za_21ka$grids[[x]]$PrDens
      if (length(val) == 0) return(NA)
    
      za_21ka$grids[[x]]$calBP[which.max(za_21ka$grids[[x]]$PrDens)]
    
    }
  
  )
)

```

```{r}
sites_sf <- st_as_sf(
  za_21ka,
  coords = c("lon", "lat"),
  crs = 4326
)

sites_proj <- st_transform(
  sites_sf,
  32734
)
 
coords <- st_coordinates(sites_proj)

za_21ka$x <- coords[,1]
za_21ka$y <- coords[,2]

study_area <- st_bbox(sites_proj) |>
  st_as_sfc() |>
  st_buffer(dist = 50000) |>
  vect()

r <- rast(
  ext(study_area),
  resolution = 10000,
  crs = st_crs(sites_proj)$wkt
)

values(r) <- 1 # Gives every cell a value
```

```{r}
grid <- as.data.frame(
  r,
  xy = TRUE,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

names(grid) <- c(
  "cell",
  "x",
  "y"
)

c14_sf <- st_as_sf(
  za_21ka,
  coords = c("x", "y"),
  crs = st_crs(sites_proj)
)

grid_sf <- st_as_sf(
  grid,
  coords = c("x", "y"),
  crs = st_crs(sites_proj)
)

cell_id <- st_nearest_feature(
  c14_sf,
  grid_sf
)

za_21ka$cell <- cell_id
```

```{r}
model_grid <- expand_grid(
  cell = 1:nrow(grid),
  time = time_grid
)

model_grid <- model_grid |>
  left_join(
    grid |>
      mutate(cell = row_number()),
    by = "cell"
  )
```

```{r}
observations <- za_21ka |>
  filter(
    calBP >= min_age,
    calBP <= max_age
  ) |>
  mutate(
    time_bin = round(calBP / temp_res) * temp_res
  ) |>
  count(
    cell,
    time_bin,
    name = "n_dates"
  )



model_grid <- model_grid |>
  left_join(
    observations,
    by = c(
      "cell",
      "time" = "time_bin"
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    n_dates = replace_na(n_dates, 0)
  )
```

```{r}
# Run first Bayesian model to estimate lambda
fit <- brm(
  n_dates ~
    1 +
    factor(cell) +
    factor(time),
  
  family = poisson(),
  
  data = model_grid,
  
  prior = c(
    prior(normal(0, 2), class = "Intercept"),
    prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b")
  ),
  
  chains = 1,
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 2000,
  
  control = list(
    adapt_delta = 0.95
  ),
  
  cores = 4,
  threads = threading(4),
  backend = 'cmdstanr'
)
```
